bullets: R-VALUE 2.2 FOR 3-SEASON COMFORT: Engineered for spring, summer, and fall camping, this sleeping pad delivers an R-Value of 2.2 for dependable ground insulation and added warmth. Tested to ASTM F3340-22 standards for reliable performance on the trail.

12.3 OZ ULTRALIGHT TRAIL CARRY: Weighing just 12.3 oz (350 g), this lightweight sleeping pad helps keep pack weight down without giving up essential comfort and insulation. An ideal camping mat for backpacking, hiking, and fast-and-light adventures.

DOUBLE-SIDED COMFORT & INSULATION: Flip the pad to match your needs: the soft foam top adds cushioning and comfort, while the heat-trapping reflective bottom helps retain warmth from the ground. A versatile foam sleeping pad for changing trail conditions.

HIVEFOLD DESIGN FOR EASY SETUP & PACKING: The folding honeycomb structure unfolds quickly when you reach camp and folds down easily when it's time to move. No inflation, pumps, or complicated setup—just unfold, sleep, fold, and go.

RUGGED, SLIP-RESISTANT & EASY TO CLEAN: Built for the outdoors with an abrasion- and moisture-resistant surface that wipes clean with a damp cloth. The anti-slip texture helps keep your sleeping pad in place for more stable, comfortable sleep in your tent.
